profile.name: Mateus Ribeiro
profile.role: Software Engineer · Tech Lead · Squad Lead
profile.tagline: Software engineer who grew from production support to squad lead. I lead teams, mentor engineers and bring AI into everyday engineering work.

highlights: Led up to 14 engineers across 3 squads
Drove Claude adoption with custom skills: 80%+ adherence to security criteria

bullets.text: Lead 3 cross-functional squads owning Ledger, Financial Services (TED, bill payment, top-ups, FX) and Backoffice.
Systems processing around 1 million transactions per day.
Led AI adoption with custom Claude skills for development and security gap analysis, reaching 80%+ adherence to security criteria.
Technical lead for the core transaction systems team; mentor and technical reference.
Drove architecture studies with Product on microservices and high availability (Java, Spring Boot).
Built card authorization features and network messaging.
Developed Ledger APIs in a microservices architecture (Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB).
Monitored transactional systems and reduced manual work through fixes and automation.
Built and maintained systems for Bradesco and OdontoPrev.
Java EE back-end for Bradesco, with DB2 and mainframe integration.
